headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams, with key players on the shelf. The Toronto Blue Jays have transferred Addison Barger to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 22, 2026, with a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase is on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 21, 2026, with left plantar fasciitis.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Kansas City Royals acquired Nate Pearson from the Houston Astros in a trade for Max Martin. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Padres in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Rays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 3-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Addison Barger Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal was made for future considerations.
